purpose: Freeze source/clock/industry semantics for Taiwan fundamental-quality research before outcome joins.

sourceHierarchy.canonicalFirstKnown: MOPS/official exchange filing receipt when exact filing/publication timestamp is captured
sourceHierarchy.prospectiveFallback: firstObservedAt from an official-source observer; treated as an upper bound, never exact publication time
sourceHierarchy.secondaryCurrentAnalytics: TWSE MOPS financial comparison/E-point service may validate formulas/current values but its database update lag must not be relabeled as first-known filing time
sourceHierarchy.deadlines: statutory filing deadlines are compliance bounds only, never knownAt

versioningRules: append new correction/restatement versions; never overwrite earlier decision-time vintage
store report period separately from knownAt/firstObservedAt/capturedAt
do not backfill current corrected statements into earlier decision dates
UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN when publication/vintage provenance is incomplete

FINANCIAL_INSTITUTIONS.reason: Official Taiwan financial comparison semantics mark generic operating-cash-flow ratios as not applicable to these groups; balance-sheet economics also differ structurally.
FINANCIAL_INSTITUTIONS.rule: Do not force industrial CFO/FCF/working-capital metrics onto financial institutions.

formulaPolicy.CFO_TO_NET_INCOME: operatingCashFlow / netIncome with sign/near-zero denominator guards

nonFrozenReasons.FCF_SIMPLE: IFRS does not define one universal free-cash-flow measure; growth vs maintenance capex is not standardized and lease classification harms comparability.
nonFrozenReasons.ROIC: Requires a frozen NOPAT/invested-capital definition and reliable operating vs financing liability decomposition.
nonFrozenReasons.netDebt: Debt is not uniquely defined under IFRS for this analytical purpose and requires a frozen liability taxonomy.

noOutcomeJoinUntil: all derived inputs are same-vintage or explicitly lagged
